piper.title: Piper voice
piper.intro: Piper makes the voice on the device itself: nothing you are answered leaves it. The first time a voice is used it is downloaded.
piper.voice.hint: default picks the language's own voice. Another voice by its name, such as en_GB-alan-low or da_DK-talesyntese-medium.
piper.cuda.hint: Only on a device with an NVIDIA graphics card and onnxruntime-gpu.
